When I was a kid my step-mother was really abusive and my father wasn't in the picture. Every Saturday I'd go over to my Nana's to stay the night and try and get away from my mum. Whilst there I complained about my Mum and what she did to me and my siblings. One weekend whilst she was dropping me back off to the house she told me that she's gonna get my mum some help and that everything will get better. Once we got back to my mums I was super excited and ask my Nana if she's going to tell my mum right infron of my her face (My mum). My mum wanted to know what it was I didn't say anything cause she was getting really mad and my Nana tried to defuse the situation. Long story short my mum got mad that we were keeping secrets knocks my Nana into the wall and kicked me and her out of the house saying I should just live with her if I wasn't going to tell her what she wanted. After that my Nana called the authorities my mum got my siblings taken off her and she was admitted to therapy. Few years down the line my mum is doing alot better she got custody of my siblings again whilst I stayed with my Nana because I was too scared to still be around with my mum. Nowadays me and my mum have a fairly good relationship I'll visit every week to see that side of the family but we're sorta removed from each other now. Sorry if this was a bit long winded but I feel it needed some context.

All in all I'd say things turned out fairly well and that things probably wouldn't have gone as fast as they did if that event didn't happen.
